2030 Census is expected to shift significant Electoral College power to Republican-leaning states, with red states gaining a net 8 to 10 votes at the expense of Democratic strongholds. 


Now for the house:

Gainers: Texas and Florida are projected to gain the most seats (typically 2–4 each).  Arizona, Georgia, Idaho, North Carolina, and Utah are each expected to gain one seat. 

Conservatively speaking, we gain 9 seats, best case 13 seats 


Losers: California is projected to lose the most seats (typically 3–4).  New York and Illinois are expected to lose 1–2 seats each.  Minnesota, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Wisconsin are projected to lose one seat each.

Conservatively speaking, they lose 10 seats! Best case for us, they lose 14 seats? 

That kind of swing will truly help shape our future for the better.
